newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Sakha Avia leases A-310-300 passenger jet.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Sakha Avia leases A-310-300 passenger jet.

text.p: State-owned Sakha Avia airline based in eastern Siberia has leased a 200-seat A-310-300 passenger jet, Airbus Industrie's Moscow office said on Wednesday.
The office spokesman told Reuters the aircraft delivery was expected in the first half of next year. He said the airline planned to lease two more jets during 1997.
"The airline plans to operate the A-310-300 on its new regular route between Yakutsk in Eastern Siberia and Anchorage in Alaska and on domestic routes," the spokesman said.
Sakha Avia operates about 100 passenger planes and a cargo fleet of Russian-made aircraft.
Currently 12 A-310 jets are operating in CIS, he added.
